summary: Colville NF, Pend Oreille County, WA: platform tower and camp in 1937, abandoned in the 1940s; the register says the site is gone and no source describes remains.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1940s; the Former Fire Lookout Sites register says it is gone. No source describes what, if anything, remains on the site.

events.note: Register gives 1937 as the built year and describes a platform tower and camp on the site that year. No source names a builder or a reason.
Abandoned in the 1940s; the sources give only the decade
Registered April 17, 2020 as US 2025, WA 496; nominated by Tammy McLeod

notes_for_editor: Three short pages agree on 1937, the platform tower and camp, and the 1940s abandonment. No source describes the site now, its access or any staffing or fires, so those are left out. Elevation (5,921 ft / 1,805 m) is in the story but has no facts key in the schema. Brief access 'unknown' kept unset. A Forest Service Harvey Creek Subwatershed Restoration summary (projects/50972) names the Harvey Creek and Paupac Creek roads but does not mention the lookout, so it is not cited. WillhiteWeb says it would add more after a visit; the cached version has no visit report.
